actions.action: Calculate all six totals from stated usage
actions.mechanism: Evaluate each plan against the same requirements, including triggered mandatory charges and explicitly selected extras.
actions.implementation: Add labeled storage, editors, guests, and export inputs. Show six totals for one billing period; mark unsupported requirements explicitly.
actions.check: Test boundary fixtures against structured pricing rules; keyboard and screen-reader users must retrieve every total and unsupported capability.
actions.risk: Ambiguous usage units or billing periods can invalidate comparisons.

actions.action: Separate included, mandatory, optional, and unavailable items
actions.mechanism: Explicit charge categories expose why a low base price may not be the payable total.
actions.implementation: Use an accessible six-plan table with row headers, textual categories, mandatory-charge triggers, and unselected optional extras. Retain every capability row.
actions.check: Give visitors two similar-base-price plans with different required add-ons; ask for usage totals and which charges they may decline.
actions.risk: Dense itemization may overwhelm; keep totals visible beside the breakdown.

actions.action: Expose the next cost-changing usage boundary
actions.mechanism: Showing nearby limits distinguishes plans that cost the same now but behave differently as usage changes.
actions.implementation: For each plan, derive the next editor, storage, guest, or export threshold. State its resulting charge or unsupported status in text.
actions.check: Test immediately below, at, and above each threshold; displayed consequences must match the calculator, including simultaneous charge triggers.
actions.risk: Thresholds are conditional on other inputs; disclose those assumptions.

actions.action: Reconcile the chosen plan before payment
actions.mechanism: A pre-payment comparison catches changed requirements or extras instead of allowing silent cost additions.
actions.implementation: Carry stated usage into checkout. Present base cost, mandatory charges, chosen extras, and total; require reconfirmation after changes. Link back to all six plans.
actions.check: Change an add-on rule between comparison and checkout; verify payment pauses and the screen reader announces the revised breakdown.
actions.risk: Confirmation becomes ineffective if differences are buried in generic consent.
